output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to mint new tokens and transfer them to any user input address. The vulnerability is in the function where it increases the balance of the new owner and decreases the balance of the contract owner without checking the balance of the new owner. This can be exploited to make the contract unable to transfer out funds.

The mintBatch function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to mint new tokens in batch and transfer them to any user input address. The vulnerability is in the function where it increases the balance of the new owner and decreases the balance of the contract owner without checking the balance of the new owner. This can be exploited to make the contract unable to transfer out funds.
